### Planning Intelligence Log

**Session date**: 2026-05-25
**Origin**: Parent bug 6e17-7424-68cc-48f8 (P0 — preplanning + completion-verifier integration defects survived epic-close on f360-3a5b). Routed via /dso:brainstorm after /dso:fix-bug triage on cherry-pick child 2b4f-167c-0747-4921 classified the work as COMPLEX (4-skill spread, net-new capability addition, not LLM-behavioral regression).

**Scope decisions**:

- **Single epic → split into two**: Scope reviewer flagged FAIL with split_recommended (4-skill spread; Gap D thematically distinct). User authorized split. This is Epic A (foundation + decomposer Design C + preplanning fan-in + regression fixture). Epic B (230a-344a-9170-4ab8) carries Gap C (verifier consumer_smoke_tests population) and Gap D (brainstorm Phase 1.5 dispatch-path detector) as a `scrutiny:pending` follow-on.

**Design decisions (user-guided through Phase 1 dialogue)**:

- **Gap A detection**: Design C hybrid (per-story inline emits_signals/consumes_signals + post-draft signal_manifest reflection + deterministic critic). Rejected Design A (reflection-only) and Design B (inline-only) as too weak on residual failure modes; rejected pure prompt directives (Design (c) in initial framing) as the original failure mode.
- **Gap B fan-in graph**: Union of `depends_on` graph and `cross_story_signals` graph. Strengthened from "fan-in ≥ 2" to "fan-in ≥ 2 in either graph OR any cross_story_signals edge at all (≥ 1)" per red-team finding — the f360 defect was a 1:1 coupling that the original ≥ 2 threshold would miss.
- **Gap C smoke-test execution model** (Epic B scope): Sibling test file at `plugins/dso/tests/contract-<canonical_name>.sh` invoked by verifier. Rejected embedded fenced code (drift risk), declarative DSL (premature abstraction), LLM-judgment (the original failure mode).
- **Gap D detection trigger** (Epic B scope): Keyword scan + LLM classifier on ambiguous matches, mirroring existing UI-Copy Detector pattern. Red-team flagged novel-vocabulary evasion; Epic B brainstorm should consider inverting (LLM classifies all, keyword scan as fast-path skip).
- **Constants doc schema**: {canonical_name, canonical_surface, semantic, producer, consumers, smoke_test} — minimal + cross-references; rejected pure-minimal (no traceability) and self-contained DSL (duplicates smoke-test content).

**Cross-epic interaction scan**: Dispatched 6 of 30 candidate batches (haiku) covering 30 of 150 open/in-progress epics; partial signal set per acceptable-failure-handling protocol. Manually verified the 5 highest-signal candidates (interface-contracts naming overlap, scratch-field handoff layer, etc.) by direct inspection.

- **0cbc-4bbb-e2f6-4da0** (External-integration verification gate) — initially classified CONFLICT by haiku; user-accepted reclassification to **consideration** (different verifier fields: in_review/VERIFICATION_STATUS vs. consumer_smoke_tests). Sequence-coordinate via shared contract.
- **1d8b-0cad-8d19-45ad** (Hidden scratch field for sub-agent handoff, in_progress) — initially AMBIGUITY; reclassified to **different layers** (scratch is per-task runtime ephemeral; signal manifest is per-epic decomposition contract). Linked relates_to.
- 10 further considerations recorded as relates_to links (4c54-4205 interface contracts namespace, 188c-47e4 stack detection schema, 4047-3cb1 Jira reconciler mutation contract, 411b-a047 mutation testing artifacts, etc.).

**Scrutiny pipeline outputs**:

| Reviewer | Score | Pass | Findings retained |
|----------|-------|------|-------------------|
| Agent Clarity | 4/5 | yes | 2 major (definitional precision: canonical-ref doc name, Design C schema inlining) addressed by inlining schema fields directly in SC2 and naming `copy-story.md` as the canonical reference in SC1 |
| Scope | 3/5 | **no — split recommended** | Split into Epic A + Epic B per major finding; minor finding on item-2 sub-deliverable conflation acknowledged (preplanning will decompose into separate stories) |
| Value | 4/5 | yes | 3 minor (single-incident baseline, SC6 weak "at least one" allowed cheapest-gate-only coverage, YAGNI on Gap D); first addressed by epic split; second addressed by RT major fixture-family fix; third addressed by epic split |
| Red Team | n/a | n/a | 6 of 7 findings retained by blue-team-filter (2 critical + 3 major + 1 underrated minor → major); 1 minor self-use-coverage finding filtered as false-positive (chicken-and-egg: Epic A cannot dogfood its own decomposer gates before shipping) |
| Blue Team | n/a | filter | 6 retained, 1 FP-filtered, 1 severity-upgraded |

**Red-team / blue-team findings applied to spec**:

1. (RT-1 critical, blue-team legit) — Typo-coherence evasion: added SC2 check (b), critic cross-checks declared surfaces against `canonical_surface` field in constants doc when a contract doc exists. Two stories agreeing on a typo no longer pass.
2. (RT-2 critical, blue-team legit) — Zero-declaration bypass: added SC4 (decomposer heuristic post-pass). Scans file_impact + story body for tag-emit / title-prefix / file-path-convention patterns; flags `undeclared-signal` when patterns detected on a zero-signal story. Lifted from Epic B's verifier layer to Epic A's decomposer layer since Epic A is the first line of defense.
3. (RT major, blue-team legit) — Fan-in 1:1 case: SC3 strengthened to fire on any cross_story_signals edge (≥ 1), not just ≥ 2.
4. (RT major, blue-team legit) — Regression fixture staleness: SC5 expanded to fixture *family* of 3 variants (tag-fork, surface-typo-coherence, zero-declaration). Each variant must independently fire ≥ 1 distinct gate.
5. (RT minor → MAJOR per blue-team) — SC1 "at least one" formulation upgraded to require pre-commit/CI hook validating every contract doc, not just a reference one.
6. (RT major, deferred to Epic B) — Classifier fragility on Gap D (novel-vocabulary evasion) noted as open question in Epic B stub for that brainstorm to address.
7. (RT minor, blue-team FP) — Self-use dogfood SC dropped (chicken-and-egg).

**Revision cycles**: 1 (initial spec drafted, scrutiny pipeline returned, spec revised once, no second cycle required — all surviving findings have remedies in the current spec).

**Workflow notes**:

- Cross-epic scan covered 30 of 150 epics (partial signal set per acceptable-failure-handling); the 4 batches with highest title-similarity to this epic were prioritized. The 120 unscanned epics are predominantly orthogonal-domain (UI library, design system, kudos, deployment infra) per title inspection.
- Cherry-pick bug 2b4f-167c-0747-4921 (Gap A child of 6e17) remains open pending close-as-superseded with bug-classifier dispatch; parent 6e17 remains open until both Epic A and Epic B close. Tracking as a follow-on session task.

**Scale context**: not applicable (agent-tooling epic with no volume-sensitive decisions).

**External dependencies**: none (plugin-internal; no CI workflow / branch-protection / release-script dependencies).

**Attestation**: exhausted — all Phase 1 gap-analysis questions resolved by user (4 design questions: detection-model C, fan-in-graph c, smoke-test-execution b, dispatch-detection a; 2 bookkeeping questions: 2b4f and 6e17 disposition close-as-superseded; 1 constants-doc-schema question: minimal + cross-references b).
